title: Lagos Controlled Collector Readiness Gate
purpose: Verify that a proposed rainwater collection assembly is ready for a controlled validation event without treating readiness as authorization, water-quality validation, or product release.
prerequisites: S6C.2 survey and location verification accepted

gates.requirement: Collector identity and configuration are uniquely recorded
Capture and drainage path inspection is documented
First-flush configuration is inspected and documented
Storage/container controls and material evidence are documented
Instrumentation identity and calibration/verification evidence are available where applicable
Event, site, collector and custody identifiers are bound before collection

transition: PASS -> S6C.4 CONTROLLED RAIN EVENT READINESS
prohibitions: No collection authorization is implied by this readiness gate
No laboratory result may be inferred
